Actions.why: One player's statistics in one match, keyed player and match; points at Matches, whose Date times it, and at Players and Teams.

Matches.why: One row per fixture of the 2011-12 season, stamped with Date and pointing at the home and away team.

Players.why: One row per footballer, id and name; Actions points at it.

Teams.why: The twenty clubs, id and name; Matches and Actions both point at it.
